meta.title: DataForge 2026 Pathway Benchmark Dataset
meta.concept: Associative Memory in Fast-Weight Architectures and Linear Recurrent State Updates

preset_01_clean.title: Clean Orthogonal Memory
preset_01_clean.description: Mutually orthogonal keys guarantee zero cross-talk interference and 100% accurate associative retrieval.

preset_02_correlated.title: Moderate Key Correlation (Visible Cross-Talk)
preset_02_correlated.description: Introducing key correlation rho = 0.45 produces visible off-diagonal Gram matrix elements and cross-talk bleeding.

preset_03_pressure.title: High Memory Pressure (N > d)
preset_03_pressure.description: Storing 12 associations in an 8-dimensional state exceeds rank capacity, compounding cumulative interference.

preset_04_failure.title: Catastrophic Cross-Talk Collapse
preset_04_failure.description: High key correlation (rho = 0.75) with N > d causes interference magnitude to overwhelm target signal, inverting retrieval direction.
